subject: Quantify.ai POC kickoff — sandbox keys, allowlist, and load-test plan
messages:
From: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@quantify.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — Quantify.ai / Redwood Inference

Hi Prioym / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We'd like to start the hands-on POC next week. Can we
kick off with a two-hour working session focused on:
- prompt review and routing for our multi-tenant pipelines
- a short load test to validate steady-state token latency
- confirming staging endpoints and API keys for our sandbox accounts

Our preferred windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 4, 10:00–12:00 or 13:00–15:00
- Wed Aug 5, 09:00–11:00

Also, before the call, can you share the VPC allowlist IPs and a short runbook for the session? We need to open a ticket with our network team.

Sana
Sana Ahmed
Head of Platform
Quantify.ai

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Ahmed <sana.ahmed@quantify.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — Quantify.ai / Redwood Inference

Hi Sana — thanks for the clear priorities. Tues Aug 4 10:00–12:00 PST works for our team; I put a tentative hold and attached a short runbook and the calendar invite (see attachments).

Quick checklist for your infra team before the session:
- Provide sandbox account emails for API key generation (we'll issue scoped test keys).
- Add the following IPs to the VPC allowlist: 52.21.134.8, 52.21.134.9, 34.219.76.12 (we'll also accept a CIDR if preferred).
- Confirm access to your staging endpoints (staging.quantify.ai) and share any auth proxy details.
- If you want us to drive the load test, please share expected concurrency (rps) and input token-length distribution.

Attachments included: Quantify_POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), staging-ips.csv (IP list), redwood-poc-calendar.ics

Agenda (2 hrs):
1) 10m introductions + goals
2) 25m prompt routing & prompt-review session (Connor leads)
3) 30m staging integration + API key handoff
4) 35m short load test (configurable traffic shapes)
5) 20m results, next steps, action items

Connor — can you prepare the load-test plan (traffic shapes + token lengths)? Monica / Stephanie, please join for onboarding and follow-up items.

Thanks,
Prioym Das
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quantify.ai POC kickoff — sandbox keys, allowlist, and load-test plan

Connor — forwarding the note from Sana. Key asks for you:
- Prepare a 10-minute primer on routing variants (single model vs. hybrid routing) and a short config we can demo.
- Build a 10/20/50 RPS traffic profile with token-length buckets: 32, 128, 512. We'll run 5-minute steady windows and a 2-minute ramp.
- Bring a small script (python) to kick off the load test from our staging runner; we'll run it from your laptop.

Stephanie — capture the action items and follow up on sandbox account creation for Quantify (they may need two test accounts).

Sample debug commands and endpoints to confirm before the call:
- POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate (api-key header)
- /metrics and /kv cache inspect endpoints (read-only access will be provided)

Let me know if any of the IPs above conflict with our ephemeral pools; I'm OK swapping to a /28 CIDR if that simplifies ops.

- Prioym

Sana — Wed Aug 5 09:00–11:00 PST is confirmed on our side. I updated the calendar invite (redwood-poc-calendar.ics) and attached the runbook v1 that Connor will reference. A few operational notes below so your DevOps has what they need: 

IP/CIDR for allowlist (preferred): 52.21.134.8/29 (covers runners + staging probes)
Hostnames for TLS: staging.redwood.ai, metrics.staging.redwood.ai
Temporary API keys: we will issue two scoped keys at the start of the call and rotate them after the POC window.
Load-test plan (short summary):
- Warmup: 60s at 5 RPS, token dist: 32
- Steady windows: 5m at 10 RPS, 5m at 20 RPS, 5m at 50 RPS
- Token length buckets: 32 (50%), 128 (35%), 512 (15%)

Owner & follow-ups:
- Connor O'Brien (solutions): will run the load script and share logs to the shared Drive folder.
- Stephanie Nguyen (CS): will send the sandbox account creation checklist and post-call notes.
- Monica Patel (AE): will capture commercial milestones and next steps on HubSpot.

Links: Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-Quantify-POC
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3245

See you Wed 09:00 PST — I'll be on the call to introduce and then hand over to Connor for the technical run.
